methods: Consumer research uses the Activate 2016 Consumer Tech & Media Research Study; reported sample sizes include n=4,000, n=2,064, n=1,003, and chart-specific samples of n=4,000 (LHS) and n=840 (RHS).
Data sources cited include company financial statements (10-K/10-Q), comScore, eMarketer, IRS exchange rates, and other named industry sources.
Activate forecasts are presented for periods such as 2016E–2021E; the forecasting model and validation approach are not specified in the excerpts.
ARPU is calculated from revenues divided by users, with chart notes specifying consolidated revenues and exceptions for particular companies.
